question: Select the carnivorous animal from the following.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Iynx.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **first** sentence of the **ninth** paragraph says that "**The carnivorous animals **like the lion, tiger, leopard, hyena, panther, jaguar, jackal, **Iynx** and puina have powerful jaws and teeth for attacking other animals."
 
• The **second** sentence of the **seventh** paragraph says that "**The leaf and grass-eating animals** include the zebra, antelope, giraffe, deer, **gazelle**, elephant and **okapi**."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that the carnivorous animal is Iynx.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 2.
